labels.forecast: Preliminary operational forecast as issued (ATCF a-deck, OFCL)

definitions.forecast: Official NHC forecast position and maximum sustained wind at each lead time, verbatim from the archived a-deck.
definitions.trackError: Great-circle distance in nautical miles between the issued forecast position and the best-track position at the same verification time.
definitions.intensityError: Absolute difference in knots between the issued forecast wind and the best-track wind at the same verification time.
definitions.coverage: Errors are reported only where HURDAT2 carries a best-track point at the exact verification time; other leads are omitted rather than interpolated.
